question: Which of the following countries will host the World Badminton Championship event 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__

• India will host the World Badminton Championship event in 2026.
 
• This prestigious event is organized by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• India has previously hosted several international badminton tournaments, showcasing its capability to manage such large-scale events.
